honest_note: ADULT LABELED-NOCICEPTOR VERDICT — read before using. This file is an honest 1-node stub, not a circuit. (1) The adult Epi descending neuron (FBbt_00052624) is the only NAMED adult nociception-related neuron class in the ontology: a direct noxious-heat sensor (Painless-dependent) that suppresses thermal nociception via AstC (Liu et al. 2023). (2) It has ZERO typed instances in any connectome dataset (VFBquery: 'no neurons from a connectome dataset are typed to it') — no API connectivity exists in any reachable form. (3) Its downstream AstC-R1-expressing targets are UNIDENTIFIED in the literature — the authors state identifying them is future work. (4) NEGATIVE RESULT: no paper names adult second-order (postsynaptic) partners of labeled nociceptive sensory neurons (ppk1/painless/dTRPA1 afferents). Adult ppk1 has no neuron class (gene FBgn0020258 only); painless has no neuron class; FBbt_00051492/00048471 (adult nociceptive PN/neuron) have 0 rows and 0 instances (GAPS.md section 7). The adult field works at genetic/behavioral level (Neely et al. 2011, PLOS ONE: painless+ nerves and TrpA1 in MD neurons required for adult thermal nociception, no named second-orders); circuit-mapped nociception (Basin/Goro/A05q, DSK descending inhibition per Oikawa et al. 2023 eLife) is LARVAL. This does NOT replace pain.json (the functional JO->giant-fiber pain-equivalent circuit, GAPS.md 7b) — it is the labeled-nociceptor complement, and the complement is empty by honest survey, not by lack of trying.

nodes.description: Adult descending neuron with a large soma in the brain; dendrites mainly in dorsal brain including optic lobe and lateral horn; extensive axonal arborization in brain (optic lobe, mushroom body, subesophageal zone) and all neuromeres of the ventral nerve cord. Responds to noxiously high temperatures via the Painless TRP channel; releases Allatostatin C (AstC), suppressing thermal nociception. (VFB term info, citing Liu et al. 2023, FBrf0256813)
nodes.name: adult Epi descending neuron

source: Literature-grounded: Liu et al. 2023, Curr Biol 33(12):2397-2406.e6 (DOI 10.1016/j.cub.2023.04.055, PMID 37201520). Node identity cross-checked against VFB (FBbt_00052624). No edges are VFBquery API rows — there are none to draw.
